source: Written for the corpus: everyday speech that looks like a reference, next to real ones.

segments.text: Mark my words, this is the day the Lord has made.
I had a job interview on Monday at 9.
John and 3 of his friends came to church.
We have 2 services, at 8 and at 10.
Turn to page 5 in your hymnal.
There were 5000 men, besides women and children.
We had some 23 visitors last week.
Numbers 6:24 says the Lord bless you and keep you.
Mark chapter 4 verse 39, peace be still.
Job 19:25, I know that my redeemer lives.
Ruth chapter 1 verse 16, where you go I will go.
